calibration.numeric_access_condition: only after exact detached-lock SHA, frozen digest, and explicit reviewer unlock

confirm.strict_qc_rule: every admitted calibration and confirmation profile must pass; no attrition

prepare.operation: hash bytes, compare canonical Git blobs, count nonempty rows without numeric conversion, and parse DSS metadata only

claim_scope_if_eventually_run: prespecified within-OEDI-package association under a conditional bus-bundle random-label null; common passive-locality diagnostic only
confirmation_population_wording: previously unanalysed in the tracked repository/current workflow and prospectively specified for this analysis
dataset_classification: profiles packaged with an external public test-system dataset; measurement provenance unspecified
full_year_residualization_disclosure: quarter-hour medians are estimated from the full confirmation year, not from a training period or out-of-sample normalization

mapping_amendment.reason: Pinned OpenDSS comment semantics make the trailing yearly tokens for S48 and S49c inactive. No identifier-based inference is permitted.

split.allocation: K=ceil(0.20*N), deterministic largest remainder, then lowest hashes
split.canonical_bus_rule: resolved active DSS Bus1 base with conductor suffix stripped, whitespace trimmed, case-folded, and no numeric coercion

threshold_disclosure: T>=0.10 was selected after the five-profile historical exploration but is prospective for the locked confirmation membership
